propositions: Epic ACs should state outcome (children closed, work landed) and must never demand signature status, because signature state is the gate's own output and restating it as a criterion defeats the certifiable:false soft-path escape hatch.

When epic ACs incorrectly demand 'closed (signed)' for children, a legitimately force-closed child story can cause the entire parent epic to hard-fail certification, erasing the certifiable signal for a fully-landed multi-story epic.

The ticket-template guidance in CLAUDE.md and the plan-review gate documentation must document the no-signature-demands-in-ACs rule with explicit cross-reference to bug 02a3 and the bf50/5f39 incident as the motivating case.
